name: Our Environment
overview: Scripture reveals that God created mankind in His image and entrusted them with dominion over all living creatures and the earth, charging them to steward and care for His creation responsibly. From the Garden of Eden, where man was placed to dress and keep the land, to the acknowledgment that the land ultimately belongs to God, these verses emphasize human accountability under divine authority. God's sustaining power over heaven, earth, and seas affirms His sovereign care, calling believers to honor Him through faithful management of the environment.
